title: Tim is great!

title: Best experience EVER!
text: It was amazing, our tour guide was a lot of fun. Kept a wonderful group dynamic, was super friendly and safe and made sure we had a wonderful time. Beautiful scenery, and a spectacular time snorkeling. Highly recommend.
author: yamilet_c

title: We had an amazing...
text: We had an amazing snorkeling and kayaking trip in Spain! The whole experience was fun, relaxed, and a fantastic way to explore the beautiful coastline and crystal-clear water. Tim was an excellent guide—friendly, knowledgeable, and made sure everyone felt comfortable and safe throughout the trip. The snorkeling was a highlight, and we got to see some beautiful marine life along the way. Highly recommend this experience, and a big thank you to Tim for making it such a memorable day! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
author: Caroline_C

author: melisae803

title: Costa Brava
text:
Great time!  Free time was not what I thought.  I thought I'd be able to snorkel or head over to the rocky cave area during free time, but it was just a flat, hot beach area (no reprieve from the sun) or about 4 restaurants to go get a drink or snack from.  We just had lunch with the tour so food wasnt necessary.  There wasn't much to do during free time.  

Kayaking part was great and we really enjoyed our guide!
author: JacquelineW1148

title: Fantastic Day!
text: Beautiful coastal kayaking and snorkeling.  Unique caves and great little history tidbits provided by our guide made for a great day!

author: 600smitht

title: Best day of our trip!
text:
My teenaged daughter and I went on this tour and had the time of our lives! Our guide, Tim, was the perfect blend of entertaining, funny and laidback. The amount of time we spent on each part of the day was perfect. 
Even as a middle aged, not particularly fit woman, I was able to participate in everything. It was challenging, but not impossible. I wish I had brought water shoes (my feet struggled with the large rocks and gravelly sand), but that's the only thing I'd have done differently. My daughter loved jumping off of all the cliffs.
